scope: GEMM and layer data efficiency; no model fitting or selection changes; no neural-network end-to-end experiment
primary_target: Each target/layer/dtype frozen best direct mean validation MAPE
retrospective_rule: Among zero-failure finite existing development rows meeting a target, minimize actual training labels, then mean MAPE, mean p90, learner, method, k. No interpolation. The existing accuracy-first frozen choices remain fixed.
seed_policy: Three-seed mean is primary; show seed min/max and all-seed-attained sensitivity; count actual distinct training-label union across seeds
counting: One aggregate label is three independent collection rounds; seven timing blocks and adaptive inner repeats are not independent labels. Validation target labels are mandatory. Component validation diagnostics and common PASS qualification belong to full search access.
accounting: Observed bundled GPU collection and CPU wall separate. Retrospective label budgets are conditional recipes. Historical worker sessions include replaced, stopped and retry sessions once; calibration, wrapper and idle gaps remain separately identified.
break_even: Report conditional label-count break-even. GPU time allocation scenarios use measured per-record historical average with explicit proportional-allocation assumption and separate timing boundaries. CPU fit-call arithmetic uses actual logged calls only.
